component.name: SyncSpace
component.summary: Send files directly to trusted devices on your local network

description.p: SyncSpace is a local-first file transfer application. It discovers nearby devices, keeps discovery separate from trust, and asks you to compare a pairing code before a device becomes trusted.
Transfers use an encrypted peer connection. The management interface is available only on the computer running SyncSpace, and files are not uploaded to a cloud relay.
